full_prompt_en: An Early Renaissance tempera panel shows an armored rider passing slowly before a walled town on a pale horse. The horse fills most of the foreground in a measured side view, its raised front leg and angled rear legs giving the still image a deliberate, almost diagrammatic movement. A narrow red bridle and a large rectangular saddle cloth mark its pale cream body; the cloth has a vermilion border and a small dark heraldic square. The rider sits erect in brownish polished plate armor, holding a thin upright staff, while a long coral-red cape hangs behind the saddle in a clear vertical strip. Behind this pair, rose-colored masonry, layered roofs, and tightly placed buildings rise across the upper field. Several very dark slender trees form a rigid counterpoint on the right, and low patterned vegetation occupies the ground. Forms are constructed with precise contours and patient small-scale detailing: armor segments, reins, masonry seams, and foliage remain legible, but modeling is shallow and slightly stylized. The palette is warm and limited, led by brick red, terracotta, dusty pink, muted ocher, cream, and deep green-black. Color spreads in broad decorative planes instead of naturalistic atmospheric haze. Shadows are gentle brown and gray touches, with quiet, even illumination across the scene. The horse, rider, trees, and buildings interlock in layered near-profile planes; the background recedes by stacked scale and position more than by seamless perspective. The result has the formal cadence of a painted chronicle, where geometry, ornament, and careful surface wear lend a historical scene its composed and slightly dreamlike presence.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅早期文艺复兴蛋彩板画表现一名披甲骑士骑着浅色马，缓缓经过有城墙的城镇。马以前景中审慎的侧面形态占据大部分空间，抬起的前腿和倾斜的后腿给静止画面一种刻意安排、近乎图解式的运动。窄红缰绳与大块矩形鞍布标记奶油色马身；鞍布有朱红边框和一块深色小纹章方形。骑士身着带褐色光泽的板甲直坐，手握细长竖杖，珊瑚红长披风在马鞍后方形成明确垂直色带。两者身后，玫红色砖石、层叠屋顶和紧密排布的房屋升至上部。右侧几棵很深色的细高树形成硬朗对位，低矮图案化植被占据地面。形体由精确轮廓和耐心的小尺度细节建成：甲片、缰绳、砌缝与叶丛都可辨，但塑形浅而略带程式化。配色温暖且克制，以砖红、赤陶、灰粉、暗赭、奶油和深绿黑为主。色彩以宽阔装饰平面扩展，而不是自然主义空气雾化。阴影仅是温和褐灰点触，场景受安静均匀光照。马、骑士、树与建筑在近侧面的层层平面中互扣；背景主要靠尺度与位置叠置后退，而非无缝透视。整体具有彩绘编年史般的正式节奏，几何、装饰与谨慎表现的表面磨损，让历史场景显得端整而微微如梦。
style_prompt_en: Early Renaissance tempera painting builds a scene from precise enclosing contours, shallow modeled volumes, and stacked planes. Broad warm fields of brick red, terracotta, dusty rose, ocher, and cream are balanced by narrow deep green-black verticals. Pale large-scale forms carry finely drawn linear details, while smaller patterned areas of masonry and foliage fill the spaces behind them. Edges are firm but handmade, with lightly worn pigment and subtle grain across a matte panel surface. Light is even and restrained; soft brown-gray shading describes folds and rounded volume without a modern photographic spotlight. Movement is conveyed through carefully angled limbs and repeated diagonals within an otherwise stable side-on composition. Geometry, ornament, and patient tiny marks give the image a formal narrative rhythm, with depth suggested by overlap and measured size changes rather than atmospheric blur.
style_prompt_zh: 早期文艺复兴蛋彩画以精确闭合轮廓、浅塑形体积和叠置平面建构画面。砖红、赤陶、灰玫瑰、赭与奶油色的大片暖色域由狭窄的深绿黑竖向形体平衡。大尺度浅色形状承载细线细节，较小的砖石与叶丛图案区域填在其后。边缘坚实却保留手工感，哑光画板表面有轻微磨旧颜料和细颗粒。光线均匀克制；柔和褐灰阴影描述褶皱与圆浑体积，而无现代摄影式聚光。运动由细心安排的斜向肢体与重复对角线传出，同时整体保持稳定侧面构图。几何、装饰与耐心的小笔痕形成正式叙事节奏，深度由叠压和有分寸的大小变化暗示，而不是空气模糊。
theme_en: An armored rider on a pale horse before a red-walled medieval town
theme_zh: 赤红城镇墙垣前骑着浅色马的披甲骑士
name: Paolo Uccello
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
